stories.headline: OpenAI Closes Record $122B Funding Round at $852B Valuation, Now at $2B Monthly Revenue

key_facts.fact: OpenAI closed a $122 billion funding round at a post-money valuation of $852 billion, the largest private funding round ever.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, we closed our latest funding round with $122 billion in committed capital at a post money valuation of $852 billion.

key_facts.fact: The round was anchored by Amazon, Nvidia, SoftBank, and Microsoft, co-led by SoftBank, a16z, D.E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG, and T. Rowe Price.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was anchored by our strategic partners Amazon, NVIDIA, and SoftBank, with continued participation from our long-term partner, Microsoft. SoftBank co-led the round alongside a16z, D. E. Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG, and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Associates, Inc.

key_facts.fact: For the first time, OpenAI raised over $3 billion from retail investors through bank channels and will be included in ARK Invest ETFs.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI, not yet public, raises $3B from retail investors in monster $122B fund raise

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is generating $2 billion in monthly revenue, with enterprise accounting for over 40% and on track to reach parity with consumer by end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: We are now generating $2B in revenue per month. At this stage, we are growing revenue four times faster than the companies who defined the Internet and mobile eras, including Alphabet and Meta.

key_facts.fact: ChatGPT has more than 900 million weekly active users and over 50 million subscribers, with 6x the monthly web visits of the next largest AI app.
key_facts.excerpt: ChatGPT is the overwhelming leader in consumer AI with more than 900 million weekly active users, and over 50 million subscribers. ChatGPT has 6x the monthly web visits and mobile sessions than the next largest AI app.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI's APIs now process more than 15 billion tokens per minute, and Codex serves over 2 million weekly users, up 5x in three months.
key_facts.excerpt: Our APIs now process more than 15 billion tokens per minute. Codex now serves over 2 million weekly users, up 5x in the past three months, with usage growing more than 70% month over month.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI expanded its revolving credit facility to approximately $4.7 billion, supported by JPMorgan Chase, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and others.
key_facts.excerpt: We have also expanded our existing revolving credit facility to approximately $4.7 billion, which gives us added flexibility as we continue to invest at scale.

stories.headline: Oracle Cuts Up to 30,000 Jobs, 18% of Workforce, as AI Infrastructure Spending Booms

key_facts.fact: Oracle is laying off between 20,000 and 30,000 employees, roughly 18% of its 162,000-person workforce, as it redirects spending toward AI data center infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle has started telling employees that it's cutting thousands of jobs, CNBC has confirmed, as the software maker deals with a plummeting stock price tied to hefty capital commitments for building out AI infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: Employees across the US, India, Canada, and Mexico received termination emails from 'Oracle Leadership' starting early Tuesday morning.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle layoffs: 30,000 jobs cut in 6 a.m. email blitz as AI spending drains cash

key_facts.fact: Oracle's stock is down 25% this year, worse than all tech megacaps, as investors question the company's heavy debt-fueled AI spending.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle, which employed 162,000 people as of May 2025, declined to comment. The company's stock price is down 25% this year, dropping more than all of tech's megacaps.

key_facts.fact: In January, Oracle announced plans to raise $50 billion in debt and equity to fund its AI buildout; its remaining performance obligations jumped 359% to $455 billion following a $300B+ OpenAI deal.
key_facts.excerpt: In September, Oracle disclosed that its remaining performance obligations, a measure of contracted revenue that has not yet been recognized, jumped 359% to $455 billion following an agreement with OpenAI worth over $300 billion.

key_facts.fact: TD Cowen analysts estimated cutting 20,000 to 30,000 employees could generate $8 billion to $10 billion in incremental free cash flow.
key_facts.excerpt: Cutting 20,000 to 30,000 employees could lead to $8 billion to $10 billion in incremental free cash flow, TD Cowen analysts wrote in a January note.

stories.headline: Dow Surges 1,125 Points in Best Day Since Spring on Iran De-Escalation Hopes

key_facts.fact: The Dow Jones surged 1,125 points (+2.5%), the S&P 500 jumped 2.9%, and the Nasdaq rallied 3.8% on Tuesday, the best day for all three since last spring.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. stocks surged to their best day since last spring, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average soared 1,125 points on Tuesday as doubt swung back to hope on Wall Street about a possible end to the war with Iran.

key_facts.fact: Despite Tuesday's rally, the S&P 500 closed its worst quarter since summer 2022 with a 4.6% loss, and major indexes each lost about 5% in March alone.
key_facts.excerpt: Worries about that and pressured profit margins for companies meant the S&P 500 closed Tuesday with its worst loss for a quarter since the summer of 2022.

key_facts.fact: Brent crude fell 3.2% to $103.97 after Iran's president said Iran has 'the necessary will to end the war' given certain requirements, and extended declines to below $100 on Wednesday.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent crude futures moved 4.1% lower to $99.76 a barrel.

key_facts.fact: On Wednesday, Asian markets surged: South Korea's Kospi rose as much as 9.1%, Japan's Nikkei gained 5.2%, and MSCI Asia ex-Japan logged its biggest one-day increase since November 2022.
key_facts.excerpt: MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan rose 4.7%, snapping a four-day losing streak to log its biggest one-day increase since November 2022.

key_facts.fact: The 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.31% from 4.44% at end of last week, while U.S. gasoline topped $4/gallon for the first time since 2022.
key_facts.excerpt: The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.31% from 4.35% late Monday and from 4.44% at the end of last week. ... the average price for a gallon of gasoline topped $4 per gallon for the first time since 2022.

key_facts.fact: Europe's STOXX 600 surged 2.3% on Wednesday, on track for its biggest daily jump in a year, led by travel stocks up 4%.
key_facts.excerpt: Europe's STOXX 600 surged 2.3% in early trade - on track for its biggest daily jump in a year - as travel stocks rose about 4% and aerospace and defence stocks were 3.6% higher.

stories.headline: Iran Drone Strikes Fully Laden Kuwaiti Oil Tanker Off Dubai, Most Significant Ship Attack in a Month

key_facts.fact: An Iranian drone hit the Al-Salmi, a fully laden Kuwait-flagged very large crude carrier, in Dubai port's anchorage zone just 31 nautical miles northwest of the emirate, starting a fire on board.
key_facts.excerpt: An Iranian drone hit a fully laden Kuwaiti oil tanker off Dubai early on Tuesday in one of the most significant attacks on a vessel in a month of war, pushing crude prices higher and heightening tension around the vital Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: All 24 crew members were safe and the fire was extinguished with no oil leakage, according to the Dubai Media Office and Kuwait Petroleum Corp.
key_facts.excerpt: The Dubai Media Office said on X later on Tuesday that the fire had been extinguished and the incident had been contained, with no oil leakage. All 24 crew members were safe.

key_facts.fact: More than 400 ships of all types were in and around the anchorage where Al-Salmi was struck at the time of the attack.
key_facts.excerpt: As of Tuesday morning, there were more than 400 ships of all types in and around the anchorage where Al-Salmi was struck, according to data compiled by Bloomberg.

key_facts.fact: The attack initially pushed WTI crude futures up nearly 4% toward $107/barrel before gains were pared later in the day on de-escalation signals.
key_facts.excerpt: The tanker attack pushed oil prices higher, with West Texas Intermediate futures jumping almost 4% toward $107 a barrel, before paring gains.

key_facts.fact: Iran has near-total control of the Strait of Hormuz and has effectively closed it to all but a trickle of vessels, paralyzing energy shipments from the Persian Gulf.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran has near-total control of the Strait of Hormuz — the narrow waterway that's the gateway to the Persian Gulf — and has effectively closed it to all but a trickle of vessels, paralyzing shipments of energy and other goods.

stories.headline: EU Considers Reviving 2022 Energy Crisis Measures as Iran War Disrupts Markets

key_facts.fact: EU Energy Commissioner Dan Jorgensen said the bloc is considering reviving measures used in 2022 during Russia's gas cuts, including gas price caps and windfall profit taxes, to address disruption from the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: The European Union is considering reviving energy crisis measures it used in 2022 when Russia slashed gas deliveries, to address the unfolding disruption to energy markets caused by the Iran war, the bloc's energy chief said on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: Jorgensen warned the disruption 'will not be short' even if peace comes soon, because 'energy infrastructure in the region has been ruined by war.'
key_facts.excerpt: It will not be short, because even if there was a peace tomorrow, there will still be consequences, because energy infrastructure in the region has been ruined by war.

key_facts.fact: European gas prices have risen more than 70% since the US-Israeli war with Iran began on February 28. EU inflation accelerated to 2.5% in March from 1.9% in February.
key_facts.excerpt: European gas prices have risen more than 70% since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began on February 28.

key_facts.fact: The EU's immediate concern is jet fuel and diesel supply: the last kerosene shipments from the Strait of Hormuz are due to arrive around April 10, after which Europe faces potential localized shortages.
key_facts.excerpt: The last kerosene shipments that passed through the Strait of Hormuz before its closure are due to arrive in Europe around April 10.

key_facts.fact: Jorgensen asked EU governments to delay non-emergency refinery maintenance to keep oil product supplies flowing.
key_facts.excerpt: Jorgensen asked governments to delay non-emergency refinery maintenance to try to keep oil product supplies flowing.

stories.headline: Google Warns Quantum Computers Could Crack Crypto Encryption With 20x Fewer Resources

key_facts.fact: Google Quantum AI published a whitepaper estimating that a quantum computer with fewer than 500,000 physical qubits could break Bitcoin's 256-bit elliptic curve cryptography, a roughly 20-fold reduction from prior estimates in the millions.
key_facts.excerpt: The paper estimates that a quantum computer with fewer than 500,000 physical qubits could break Bitcoin's 256-bit elliptic curve cryptography, a roughly 20-fold reduction from prior estimates that hovered in the millions.

key_facts.fact: The researchers compiled two optimized quantum circuits for Shor's algorithm: one using fewer than 1,200 logical qubits with 90 million Toffoli gates, and another with fewer than 1,450 logical qubits with 70 million Toffoli gates.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's researchers compiled two optimized quantum circuits implementing Shor's algorithm for the elliptic curve discrete logarithm problem (ECDLP-256): one using fewer than 1,200 logical qubits with 90 million Toffoli gates, and another using fewer than 1,450 logical qubits with 70 million Toffoli gates.

key_facts.fact: A quantum attacker could derive a Bitcoin private key in approximately 9 minutes once a transaction is broadcast, just under the typical 10-minute block confirmation window, giving about a 41% success rate.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's analysis suggests that once a Bitcoin transaction is broadcast and a private key exposed on-chain, a quantum attacker could derive the private key and hijack the transaction in approximately nine minutes.

key_facts.fact: Roughly 6.9 million BTC sit in addresses where public keys have been exposed, including about 1.7 million from Bitcoin's early years, making them vulnerable to quantum attacks.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's research identified roughly 6.9 million BTC already sitting in addresses where public keys have been exposed, including approximately 1.7 million from Bitcoin's early years.

key_facts.fact: A simultaneous Caltech/Oratomic paper on arXiv shows neutral-atom quantum computers could execute similar attacks with as few as 10,000 physical qubits, 50x more efficient than Google's estimate.
key_facts.excerpt: A simultaneous paper from Caltech and quantum startup Oratomic demonstrates that neutral-atom quantum computers could execute similar attacks with as few as 10,000 physical qubits, or roughly 50 times more efficient than Google's superconducting-qubit estimate.

key_facts.fact: Google released the research using a zero-knowledge proof to verify the circuits exist without revealing implementation details, signaling the seriousness of the threat.
key_facts.excerpt: Google released its research using a novel disclosure method: a zero-knowledge proof verifying the quantum circuits exist without revealing implementation details.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Corcept's Lifyorli for Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer, First Selective SGRA

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Lifyorli (relacorilant) in combination with nab-paclitaxel for adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer, making it the first FDA-approved selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist.
key_facts.excerpt: Lifyorli is the first FDA-approved selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist (SGRA). It competitively binds to the glucocorticoid receptor (GR), where it enhances chemotherapy sensitivity by inhibiting cortisol's suppression of apoptosis.

key_facts.fact: In the pivotal ROSELLA trial, patients treated with Lifyorli plus nab-paclitaxel experienced a 35% reduction in risk of death compared to nab-paclitaxel alone, with median overall survival of 16.0 months vs 11.9 months.
key_facts.excerpt: patients treated with Lifyorli in addition to nab-paclitaxel experienced a 35% reduction in the risk of death compared to patients treated with nab-paclitaxel alone, with a median overall survival (OS) of 16.0 months, compared to 11.9 months.

key_facts.fact: Patients also saw a 30% reduction in risk of disease progression as assessed by blinded independent central review.
key_facts.excerpt: Patients who received Lifyorli in addition to nab-paclitaxel also experienced a 30% reduction in the risk of disease progression, as assessed by blinded independent central review (PFS-BICR).

key_facts.fact: Corcept CEO Dr. Joseph Belanoff said the approval demonstrates the potential of cortisol modulation in oncology.
key_facts.excerpt: It is a privilege to bring forward a new treatment for patients who historically have had few options. We have worked for years to demonstrate the potential of cortisol modulation in oncology.
